neighbours.label: a short list of head tokens in fixed technical or set phrases: ' mass' after 'invariant', 'ilog' in antilog, '_log' in inverse_log, ' Energy' after 'Alternative', ' light' after 'true'
fire: Physicists searched the invariant mass distribution for a narrow peak.
Students computed the antilog of each interval limit by hand.
The Alternative Energy office funds solar projects in the county.
The hymn praises Jesus as the true light of the nations.
They plotted the dimuon invariant mass from the 2011 collisions.
Taking the antilog gives the geometric mean of the group.
Cox runs an Alternative Energy program with local farmers.
quiet: Physicists searched the energy distribution for a narrow peak.
Students computed the logarithm of each interval limit by hand.
The Renewable Power office funds solar projects in the county.
The hymn praises Jesus as the good shepherd of the nations.
They plotted the dimuon angle from the 2011 collisions.
Taking the root gives the geometric mean of the group.
Cox runs a Solar Power program with local farmers.

notes: Card: _log, Energy, m, den, mass, ilog, with no shared token. I could not find the pattern: same-frame phrases failed. Probes: invariant mass 0.742, inverse_log 0.700, Alternative Energy 0.579, antilog 0.550, true light 0.476, but 'Dark Energy' 0.007, 'true vine' 0.044, 'invariant measure' 0.024, 'average mass' 0.022, 'logarithm' 0.018. So it stays a list, tested with new sentences, and it may be a set of near-memorised strings.
